subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five memory roles and per-agent overrides as the durable config/plugin API, and if so must legacy `plugins.slots.memory` be Doctor-migrated to one canonical owner rather than retained as a second runtime-readable key?
rationale: The code can implement either compatibility model, but automation cannot choose permanent public role names, unsupported future lifecycle semantics, or whether third-party legacy readers justify two persisted sources of truth.

options.title: Canonical roles with Doctor migration
options.body: Sponsor the role taxonomy, require runtime and plugins to consume one resolved canonical owner, migrate legacy config through Doctor, and refresh exact-head upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Retain a dated legacy alias
options.body: Allow both keys temporarily only with an explicit conflict rule, synchronized mutation behavior, plugin deprecation documentation, removal release, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Pause for the memory RFC
options.body: Keep the implementation open but do not merge public config or SDK surface until the role taxonomy and missing dreaming/user-model protocols are approved in the canonical architecture discussion.

recommendation.title: Canonical roles with Doctor migration
recommendation.body: Sponsor the role taxonomy, require runtime and plugins to consume one resolved canonical owner, migrate legacy config through Doctor, and refresh exact-head upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the closest plugin activation and memory coexistence boundaries needed to decide this contract.
